content.short: Hop enables cross-chain token transfers between popular layer-2 networks.
content.description: Hop is a token-bridging application launched in 2021 that enables users to easily send popular cryptocurrencies such as ETH, MATIC, and USDT between the Ethereum mainnet and layer-2 networks. The protocol currently supports Arbitrum, Optimism, Gnosis, Polygon, and Ethereum networks. Like many DEXs, Hop Protocol offers rewards through liquidity provision and supports multiple blockchains. This combination provides cross-chain transfer capabilities across several major networks, facilitating movement of assets between chains.
